Message:
I couldn’t forget
the sight of
my friend crying,
so I stayed near
the outskirts of town.

Even if only from a distance,
I just wanted to see her smile...
One last time before I died.

As I drew closer to town,
I noticed something strange...

The place I’d once called home
was now covered
in unfamiliar vines.

I ran towards someone
lying limp on the ground,
but they had already...

For a moment, I thought
this was all my fault.
But, it must have been
all these vines...

The flowers blooming
all along the vines
were plump and vibrant...

as if they thrived by
feeding on the living.
They were almost
too horrifying to look at.

My mind was racing
as I rushed to look for my friend,
but I managed to quickly find her.

But, the vines
wrapping around her...
were littered with buds.
